editorial.blurb: A warm, intimate spot serving comforting noodle and rice dishes with genuine care from owners who make sure every guest leaves smiling.
editorial.insiderTip: Come when it's not too busy for that pleasant, intimate atmosphere—try a few different menu items across visits, and don't miss their authentic boba teas, especially the mango with jelly.

topDishes.note: delicious and authentic, a customer favorite
